deployment.destination: actual R/remote_setup/<child.unit_id>, preserving its four existing standard records
deployment.parent_standard_records: remain in actual R/data/<parent.unit_id>; never copied over packet standards
deployment.runtime_source: exact reviewed actual helper plan, no changing d146 runtime paths

publication.source_freeze: launcher_source_freeze.json files absolute-path to SHA map containing all immutable_artifacts inputs and mandatory source/test/prepared/static records

qualification_scope: No scientific/profile/case/idea/packing/final/worker credit. Actual full target success plus independent raw review and a separate admission remain required. Whole-job fixture transitions are unknown, never assigned zero.

required_actual_review_files.launcher_independent_review.json: independent_profile_target_qualification_prepared_launcher_review, source_freeze/prepared_binding exact refs and approved/passed/independent_of_producer true
required_actual_review_files.packet_static_verification.json: passed true and prepared_binding exact ref
required_actual_review_files.parent/controller_launch_independent_rev: independent_profile_target_qualification_controller_launch_review, actual parent/child plan refs, approved/passed/independent_of_producer true
required_actual_review_files.release_independent_review.json: independent_profile_target_qualification_release_review, fixed release binding exact ref and approved/passed/independent_of_producer true

root_only_action_order: publish actual source+prepared records+genuine independent reviews
--submit-held-once --publication-commit <actual published commit> (three ledgers fsync before actual receipt; never repeat)
--prepare-release --publication-commit <actual published commit> (query exact ledger-owned held ID)
independently review and publish actual fixed-ID release binding and snapshot refs
--release-once --publication-commit <actual new published commit> (fresh exact owned held query/named reservation check; successful release receipt fsync before atomic child envelope; never repeat)
